preamble: answers must be entered in a consistent manner, always producing a real word or phrase as the grid entry. Numbers in brackets refer to the clues’ answers, not their entries. Downs are normal.

solutions.check: grid and clues read from the Guardian's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; each light's entry one fifteensquared prints for it, the only choice of them whose crossings all agree; an entry not its answer carries the answer as its alteration's `from`

clue.text: Appear before Geordie entertainer on drugs, holding his partner up

parts.note: Ant McPartlin, the Newcastle-born half of the TV duo Ant and Dec

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means the partner's name is written bottom to top
holding means the drug letters wrap around something placed inside them

parts.note: E is ecstasy, so two of them make drugs; they sit either side of the partner
Dec Donnelly is Ant's television partner

explanation.surface: A Tyneside celebrity turns up high, propping up his double-act partner.
explanation.walkthrough: Ant and Dec are a British TV presenting duo from Newcastle; 'on' places the Geordie on top of the rest, and E is the usual shorthand for ecstasy.
explanation.definitionFit: To antecede is to precede or come earlier, in time or position.

clue.text: Middle eastern ruler needing peace, I see

parts.note: sh is a call for peace and quiet
ah is what you say when you see the point

explanation.definitionFit: The shah was the monarch of Iran, a country of the Middle East, until 1979.

clue.text: Winnie's friend holding husband's comb

parts.note: Kanga is the kangaroo in A. A. Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh stories
H is the standard abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: Pooh's companion has hold of her spouse's comb.
explanation.walkthrough: The H goes inside KANGA between its G and final A.
explanation.definitionFit: A kangha is the small wooden comb worn by Sikhs as one of the five articles of faith.

clue.text: Leader of sales personnel puts pen marks on contracts

clue.text: Eye movement from priest turning up info on church

explanation.definitionFit: Vergence is the turning of the two eyes towards or away from each other to focus at different distances.

clue.text: Representation of sun to Degas in part of studio

clue.text: Disallow touring outskirts of nice Italian region

clue.text: Drop cat from the east in river

clue.text: Real and City heading for half time

clue.text: Huge monarch's put on a lot of weight
